title: The Pre-Fashioned Containments of Providence
description: A litany of seven "beforehand" provisions showing that for every category of evil to break out, the Father of Life had already shaped the binding-place that would hold it. Three fossae, the wall in the sea, the Adamas pinning Hyle between four winds, the abyss for the archonic host, the prison for the Watchers, even the twelve cities of the Giants — every eruption of self-love met by a form prepared before it.
